popCulture.title: Metamorphoses
popCulture.creator: Ovid
popCulture.description: Book 8: Erysichthon fells Ceres' oak and Famine sits in his gut — Mestra sold again and again until the king eats himself.

popCulture.title: Hymns (Callimachus)
popCulture.creator: Callimachus
popCulture.description: Hymn 6 to Demeter — the Hellenistic source Ovid reworked: sacrilege in the grove and hunger that ruins a house.

popCulture.title: Erysichthon of Thessaly
popCulture.description: The Thessalian king punished with endless hunger — still the mythic face of appetite that no feast can fill.
